optimizedDescription.value: ArchiveChange merges deltas, publishes specs atomically, moves change to archive, runs hooks; gated on archivable.

optimizedContext.value:
# ArchiveChange
## Rules
### Ports and constructor
- Inject: `ChangeRepository`, `ReadonlyMap<string, SpecRepository>`, `ArchiveRepository`, `RunStepHooks`, `ActorResolver`, `ArtifactParserRegistry`, `ExtractorTransformRegistry`, `SchemaProvider`, `RegenerateSpecMetadata`, `SpecWorkspaceRoute[]`.
- Hooks via `RunStepHooks` only — no direct `HookRunner`.
- `SchemaProvider` lazy-caching; replaces SchemaRegistry+schemaRef+paths.
- `specs` keyed by workspace; multi-workspace lookup by spec ID.
- `ArtifactParserRegistry`: format → parser for delta apply.
- `ExtractorTransformRegistry` + routes for pre-pub `extractMetadata` / `resolveInitialPersistedDependsOn()`.
- Metadata via `RegenerateSpecMetadata` (forced post-commit) — not Generate+Save directly.
### Input
- `name`; `skipHookPhases` (`'pre'|'post'|'all'`, default empty); `allowOverlap` (default false).
### Schema name guard
- `schema.name()` vs `change.schemaName` → `SchemaMismatchError` before archivable guard/hooks/writes.
### ArchivedChange construction
- `ArchiveRepository.archive(change, { actor })` → `ArchivedChange` in result. Use case never builds it.
### Archivable guard
- `change.assertArchivable()`; else `InvalidStateTransitionError`. Passes for `archivable` or `archiving` (retry).
### Deferred transition to archiving
- After full-batch preflight + batch snapshots: `ChangeRepository.mutate` → assertArchivable → `transition('archiving')` if needed — immediately before first `publish()`.
- Overlap, readOnly, pre-hooks, preflight stay in `archivable`. Pre-hooks step `'archiving'` without needing state `archiving`.
### ReadOnly workspace guard
- Before hooks/writes: any `readOnly` ownership → `ReadOnlyWorkspaceError` (lists specs). Stay `archivable`.
### Overlap guard
- `list()` → `detectSpecOverlap` excluding self. `allowOverlap:false` → `SpecOverlapError`; `true` → invalidate overlapping changes.
### Pre-archive hooks
- Unless skip `all`/`pre`: `RunStepHooks.execute({ name, step:'archiving', phase:'pre' })`. Fail → `HookFailedError`; no transition/snapshots/writes.
### Tracked artifact selection
- Use tracked `ArtifactFile.filename` only — no alternate deltas/specs path probing. Direct `specs/...` authoritative if tracked.
### Prepare archive plan / staged commit
- Full-batch preflight (resolve, apply deltas, plan writes, all fail-able checks) before any canonical publish. Fail → no publish for any spec.
- Safety: batch preflight atomicity; per-spec publish atomicity; batch snapshot+restore. Commit fail → restore all before return.
### Batch canonical snapshot / restore
- After preflight, before archiving transition: copy pre-existing files to `<specDir>/.specd-archive-backup/` + `manifest.json` (`changeName`, `specDirExisted`, `existingFiles`, `createdFiles`). Exclude `.specd/metadata/.../metadata.json`.
- Restore reverse publish order; delete backups after success. Partial restore fail → stay `archiving`, no auto-rollback to archivable.
### Orphan backup detection
- Matching `changeName` → auto-restore, delete backup, abort+retry guidance. Foreign/unreadable → abort, no publish.
### Lifecycle rollback after failed commit
- Successful batch restore → `archive-failed` event (`commitStarted:true`) + transition `archiving`→`archivable`. Else stay `archiving`.
### Delta merge and spec sync
- Per `scope:spec` artifact: delta:true → apply via parser (missing delta → copy primary); delta:false → copy tracked file. Preserve markdown styles; deterministic mixed markers.
### Archive repository call
- Resolve actor first (fail → restore). Then `archive()`. Delete all backups before metadata/post-hooks.
- `archivedName` = `YYYYMMDD-HHmmss-<name>` from `change.createdAt` (not wall clock).
### Archive index metadata
- Increment `.specd-index-meta.json` `totalCount` atomically after success.
### Post-archive hooks
- Unless skip `all`/`post`: phase `'post'`. Failures → `postHookFailures` (no rollback).
### Spec metadata generation
- Preflight: seal `dependsOn`, lock content, `extractMetadata`, mismatch aborts. Post-archive: `RegenerateSpecMetadata.execute({ specId })`; failures → `staleMetadataSpecPaths` (non-fatal).
### spec-lock sidecar
- Publish via `SpecRepository.publish({ persistedState, expectedRevision })` — not separate `writePersistedState()`. Use `applyPersistedSpecStatePatch`; copy `optimizations` unchanged. Schema immutable once lock exists.
### Result / typed errors
- Result: `archivedChange`, `postHookFailures`, `staleMetadataSpecPaths`, `invalidatedChanges`.
- Typed: `ArchiveDependencyMismatchError`, `ArchiveArtifactMissingError`, `ArchiveImplementationStateError`, `ArchivePreflightError`.
### Implementation guards
- No tracked impl file `open`. Materialize confirmed links → `workspace:path`; fail out-of-`codeRoot`; default fail out-of-scope sidecar updates unless `--allow-out-of-scope`.
### Factory
- `createArchiveChange(config)` → `resolveArchiveChangeDeps` → canonical `createArchiveChange(deps)`.
## Constraints
- assertArchivable before hooks/snapshots/writes; readOnly+overlap while archivable.
- Pre-hook fail aborts (no transition/snapshots/partial writes).
- Transition to archiving only after preflight+snapshots, before first publish.
- Commit fail → batch restore; rollback to archivable only if restore OK.
- Post-hooks/metadata fail do not roll back successful archive move.
- Never `invalidate()` archived change; never construct `ArchivedChange`; hooks only via `RunStepHooks`.
